verdict.rationale: Cake documents a read-only MCP integration that answers questions about shareholders, share classes, SAFEs/notes, option pools and vesting from the live cap table. That is programmatic access covering the story's data domains, but it is built for querying through an AI assistant, not as a general developer data API. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the candidate paths. Missing for 10: a documented REST/GraphQL API with endpoint reference, structured bulk retrieval of the full cap table (stakeholders, classes, securities, vesting states), auth/developer docs, and independent corroboration.
